scope: Read-only structural diagnosis while the sole price-balance solver pipeline waits; no new performance candidate, solver or production edit
question: Would a complete partition by active warehouse subset materially reduce the customer-assignment state universe, and what exact coverage obligations would it have?
method: For original M4 shared-customer necessary assignment domains D_c, compute exact counts for each nonempty used-site subset A by inclusion-exclusion: N(A)=sum_{B subset A}(-1)^(|A|-|B|) product_c |D_c intersect B|. Sum all N(A) equals product_c|D_c|. Validate against independent direct enumeration on tiny cases, including repeated-customer orders. Match existing physical schedule's shared assignment and warehouse mask.
correctness_boundary: Counts are assignment candidates before original capacity/time/inventory/physical scheduling, not feasible-schedule counts or runtime estimates. A valid exact decomposition would have to include every feasible mask, keep all original delivery/pickup and shared assignment/physical constraints, aggregate GLOBAL LB as minimum across all mask subproblem LBs, and prove integer optimum only after every remaining mask closes or is validly pruned by global incumbent. Restricted-mask proof alone is not full proof.
inputs: Two frozen20customer M4 sources and8 tiny original cases(4repeatedcustomer), unmodified original domains and schedules
budget: Pure count/audit arithmetic only, no Gurobi model; no solver timing during external heavy runs
decision: Diagnostic only. Do not start another candidate while M4 price balance is unresolved, and do not implement blind mask decomposition before reviewing counts and full proof/budget obligations.
